source_caption:
In this scene from A Knight's Tale (2001), the quotation from Joshua 10:12–13, spoken by Heath Ledger, is often said to have been completely improvised without the director’s knowledge.

Brian Helgeland liked the subtlety and power of the moment so much that he kept it in the final cut.

source_details.title: A Knight's Tale
source_details.synopsis: A Knight's Tale is a 2001 American medieval action comedy film written, co-produced and directed by Brian Helgeland. The film stars Heath Ledger as William Thatcher, a peasant squire who poses as a knight and competes in tournaments, winning accolades and acquiring friendships with such historical figures as Edward the Black Prince (James Purefoy) and Geoffrey Chaucer (Paul Bettany). Its 14th-century story is intentionally anachronistic, with many modern pop culture references and a soundtrack featuring 1970s music.
